> ***Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:***

**Step 1:** To register as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board, an applicant worker should download [Form No-28](http://bocw.punjab.gov.in/userfiles/file/Registration%20Form%2028%20updated.pdf) and attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required).
**Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Labour Inspector of your area.
> ***Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:***

**Step 1:** A registered worker should download [Form No-37](https://bocw.punjab.gov.in/userfiles/file/BOCW%20Scheme%20Forms/Exgratio%20Form%2037.pdf) and attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required).
**Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Labour Inspectors of your area.
&gt; ***Note:***


  - **Registration with the Board:** A construction worker becomes a member of the board by filling out Application Form No 28 along with depositing registration fees of ₹ 25/- only (once in life) and ₹ 10/- per month as contribution fees. children.text: For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:
The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant should have a monthly income of ₹15,000/- or below.
The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
The applicant should not be an income tax payer.
For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:
The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
The member should have complete or partial disability.
The member should not possess Health Cards issued under the Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.

> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


  - The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
  - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
  - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
  - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
  - The applicant should have a monthly income of ₹15,000/- or below.
  - The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
  - The applicant should not have membership of the Employees&#39; Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees&#39; State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
  - The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


  - The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
  - The member should have complete or partial disability.
  - The member should not possess Health Cards issued under the Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The "Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the registered worker in the event of complete or partial disability.

children.text: The "Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, the Board shall provide compensation to the registered worker in the event of complete or partial disability who do not have Health Cards under Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The &quot;Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation&#39;&#39; by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, the Board shall provide compensation to the registered worker in the event of complete or partial disability who do not have Health Cards under Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.
